integrity: The source provides an exhaustive dyadic family of finite autojoins. Given its exact order and addition laws, the ordered-semigroup identification is immediate, while the Grothendieck completion and automorphism classification are proved from first principles. The access limitation to the primary PDF is disclosed rather than treated as proof of absence.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns Cintioli's specific exact-realization witness and its canonical direct-sum operation. The group completion adds formal negative dyadic elements and is not itself an internal degree structure. Direct primary-PDF access was unavailable, so the scalar formulas were cross-checked against the primary abstract and a detailed source-focused review.
title: Autojoin rigidifies Cintioli's dense bounded finite-one degree
